## Changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. If a check was skipped, explain why.
For manual testing, include the OS, simulator mode and relevant GPU or field package.

- [ ] Ran `just verify`.
- [ ] The `CI required` check passed on the latest PR commit.
- [ ] For native or platform changes, linked a Full validation run or explained why it is deferred.
- [ ] Updated relevant docs and `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Checked that logs and attachments contain no secrets or private data, and no external CAD or SDK files are included.
